ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 85% low-intensity (black) central surface area vs 15% high-intensity (cyan/white) distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black mass spanning the peduncle attachment to mid-lobes; high-intensity teal-white blobs localized at the lateral distal tips (left and right edges) containing internal low-intensity linear striations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 55-degree pixel angle; moderate depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency peaks and valleys, particularly near the mid-section; the left lobe displays a smoother contour with fewer pronounced deviations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory from the median notch extending laterally to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) localized within the high-intensity light regions of both the left and right distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced dark, irregular mass (potential biological growth or entanglement debris) attached to the extreme lateral point of the left fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, thick vertical black line (rake mark) at the right distal tip that creates a high-contrast division within the light teal pigmentation zone.
